title: Jason 遙控水下機器人
summary: 以Jason有纜科學機器人為案例，沿岸端電源、纜線、控制台、機械手與樣本一路追蹤能量和資料；比較纜線拖曳與載具本體阻力。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use the tethered science ROV Jason to trace energy and data from source through tether, console, manipulator and sample, distinguishing tether drag from vehicle drag. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 先區分纜線水中重量與端部負載：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Separate tether submerged weight and end load: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 先區分纜線水中重量與端部負載 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Separate tether submerged weight and end load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先區分纜線水中重量與端部負載：垂直纜線簡化張力由水中有效自重和端部負載累積；沿線拖曳需另加向量分量。 本步以「柔性纜線與張力帳」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Separate tether submerged weight and end load: Simplified vertical-line tension accumulates submerged self-weight and end load; distributed drag adds separate vector components. Use Flexible-line tension ledger to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Jason 遙控水下機器人實際規格：有效線重w=5 N/m、長L=200 m、端部力500 N。式 T=wL+Fend，基準結果 1500 N。條件：直垂靜線，不含懸鏈線、彎曲剛度、動態與強度；不作纜線選型。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Jason remotely operated vehicle: Effective line weight w=5 N/m, L=200 m, end load 500 N. Formula T=wL+Fend gives 1500 N. Conditions: Straight vertical static line excluding catenary, bending, dynamics and strength; not cable selection.
steps.failure: 用空氣中線重會高估水中自重，卻仍可能漏掉海流拖曳；不可相互抵銷錯誤。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Air weight overstates submerged weight but may still omit current drag; the errors must not be assumed to cancel. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 沿纜線每隔一段累加有效重量，檢查頂端張力大於下端；分清空氣重與水中重。 本案例另須檢查「先區分纜線水中重量與端部負載」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Accumulate effective weight along sections and check top tension exceeds bottom tension; distinguish air and submerged weight. Also check that Separate tether submerged weight and end load and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：先區分纜線水中重量與端部負載。在ROV控制室照片、纜線模型、控制延遲曲線與樣本架完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加有效線重10%，保持長度與端力，重算頂端張力。 算式區的基準值為1500，改變後為1600 N。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Separate tether submerged weight and end load. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the ROV control-room photo, tether model, control-delay traces and sample rack. Increase effective line weight alone by 10%, fix length and end load and recalculate top tension. Baseline 1500 changes to 1600 N. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
水中纜線的重量與空氣中完全相同。
optionsEn: Separate tether submerged weight and end load: Simplified vertical-line tension accumulates submerged self-weight and end load; distributed drag adds separate vector components.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.

Accumulate effective weight along sections and check top tension exceeds bottom tension; distinguish air and submerged weight. Also check that Separate tether submerged weight and end load and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

steps.instruction: 將纜線拖曳與本體拖曳分開：阻力的簡化平方律包含流體密度、阻力係數、迎流面積和相對速度；係數會隨流況改變。 本步以「流速與阻力」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。

steps.objective: 區分 將纜線拖曳與本體拖曳分開 的失效原因，提出能排除替代解釋的檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish failure causes in Separate tether and body drag with a check that rules out an alternative explanation.
steps.instruction: 忽略水流使對地速度被當成對水速度，阻力估計失真；獨立加入流速資料。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring current substitutes ground speed for through-water speed and biases drag; add independent current data. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Jason 遙控水下機器人實際規格：ρ=1025 kg/m³，CD=0.8，A=0.4 m²，相對速度v=0.6 m/s。式 D=ρCDAv²/2，基準結果 59.04 N。條件：定常不可壓縮教學模型；未含波阻、附加質量與纜線耦合。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Jason remotely operated vehicle: ρ=1025 kg/m³, CD=0.8, A=0.4 m², relative speed v=0.6 m/s. Formula D=ρCDAv²/2 gives 59.04 N. Conditions: Steady incompressible teaching model excluding wave drag, added mass and tether coupling.
steps.failure: 忽略水流使對地速度被當成對水速度，阻力估計失真；獨立加入流速資料。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring current substitutes ground speed for through-water speed and biases drag; add independent current data. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 從虛構拖曳資料作D對v²圖，檢查截距、感測器零偏與是否真的固定迎流面積。 本案例另須檢查「將纜線拖曳與本體拖曳分開」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Plot synthetic drag against squared speed and inspect intercept, sensor offset and whether frontal area stayed fixed. Also check that Separate tether and body drag and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 將纜線拖曳與本體拖曳分開
knowledge.text: 忽略水流使對地速度被當成對水速度，阻力估計失真；獨立加入流速資料。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring current substitutes ground speed for through-water speed and biases drag; add independent current data. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：將纜線拖曳與本體拖曳分開。在ROV控制室照片、纜線模型、控制延遲曲線與樣本架完成資料或紙面模型練習。只提高相對速度10%，比較平方律的21%增幅。 算式區的基準值為59.04，改變後為71.4384 N。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Separate tether and body drag. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the ROV control-room photo, tether model, control-delay traces and sample rack. Raise relative speed alone by 10% and compare the 21% quadratic increase. Baseline 59.04 changes to 71.4384 N. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
速度提高10%，阻力必定只提高10%。
忽略水流使對地速度被當成對水速度，阻力估計失真；獨立加入流速資料。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
A 10% speed increase necessarily causes only a 10% drag increase.
Ignoring current substitutes ground speed for through-water speed and biases drag; add independent current data.
quiz.explanation: 忽略水流使對地速度被當成對水速度，阻力估計失真；獨立加入流速資料。 從虛構拖曳資料作D對v²圖，檢查截距、感測器零偏與是否真的固定迎流面積。 本案例另須檢查「將纜線拖曳與本體拖曳分開」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring current substitutes ground speed for through-water speed and biases drag; add independent current data. Plot synthetic drag against squared speed and inspect intercept, sensor offset and whether frontal area stayed fixed. Also check that Separate tether and body drag and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.
